objects.name: Technology Cost Curve
objects.purpose: Determine whether a technology is becoming economically deployable through persistent PIT cost/performance improvement.
objects.output_contract: PIT cost-curve evidence, raw slope, direction/state, uncertainty, data-quality flags and falsifiers; no P score.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Adoption Acceleration
objects.purpose: Measure whether adoption is moving from local experimentation toward broad diffusion using level, velocity and acceleration separately.
objects.output_contract: PIT penetration, velocity, acceleration, denominator lineage, state and falsifiers; no P score.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Narrative Velocity
objects.purpose: Measure marginal narrative diffusion and acceleration rather than popularity level alone.
objects.output_contract: Narrative attention level, velocity, acceleration, source coverage, uncertainty and falsifiers; no scalar N score.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Narrative Saturation
objects.purpose: Detect consensus saturation, counter-narrative growth and endogenous decay/reversal pressure.
objects.output_contract: Source saturation, counter-narrative pressure, decay/reversal risk, uncertainty and mutation warnings; no scalar N score.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Market Share Acceleration
objects.purpose: Test whether value capture is concentrating toward the subject faster than the relevant market grows.
objects.output_contract: PIT market-share level and acceleration, denominator lineage, right-tail evidence and falsifiers; no X score or winner certainty.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Bottleneck Scarcity
objects.purpose: Determine whether a subject controls a scarce bottleneck capable of concentrating right-tail value capture.
objects.output_contract: Structured bottleneck state covering tightness, persistence, control, substitution risk and counterevidence; no scalar Xs score.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 reference implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Conditional Tail Activation
objects.purpose: Estimate how current PIT states change the conditional probability of predefined extreme outcomes without claiming black-swan certainty.
objects.output_contract: Conditional extreme-event probability with uncertainty, calibration, false alarms, lead-time diagnostics and explicit predictive/causal status.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Extreme Regime Shift
objects.purpose: Detect whether the return/risk process is transitioning into a statistically distinct tail regime.
objects.output_contract: Regime posterior, transition probability, tail-risk summary, state stability and calibration diagnostics; no trading action.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Payoff Convexity Geometry
objects.purpose: Evaluate whether the chosen exposure preserves upside openness while bounding or structurally limiting downside after premium and costs.
objects.output_contract: Scenario payoff distribution, right-tail capture, left-tail damage, break-even geometry and cost/IV sensitivity; no trade recommendation.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Reverse DCF Expectations
objects.purpose: Infer the growth, margin and value-capture assumptions already embedded in current price so valuation acts as the strike/entry condition for payoff.
objects.output_contract: Implied growth/margin/value-capture assumptions, sensitivity surface, expectation-gap state and falsifiers; target price prohibited.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Ruin and Expected Shortfall Constraint
objects.purpose: Determine whether the portfolio remains inside explicit survival boundaries under adverse distributions, drawdowns and liquidity stress.
objects.output_contract: Ruin/ES/drawdown/liquidity breach diagnostics and uncertainty under declared constraints; no portfolio weight or position size recommendation.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized

objects.name: Robust Fractional Kelly
objects.purpose: Research how growth-optimal sizing references should be discounted for estimation uncertainty and explicit survival constraints.
objects.output_contract: Unconstrained Kelly reference, robust/fractional admissible research range, uncertainty sensitivity and hard-constraint effects; recommended position size prohibited.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; R4 deterministic implementation not yet authorized
